newsitem.title: UK: Hoverspeed carries over 100,000 passengers in week.
newsitem.headline: Hoverspeed carries over 100,000 passengers in week.

text.p: Hoverspeed Fast Ferries, a division of Sea Containers Ltd, said on Tuesday it carried more than 100,000 passengers in a single week for the first time ever in the week ending August 16.

The company, which offers services from Dover in England to Calais in France and from the English port of Folkestone to the French port of Boulogne, said the introduction of its SuperSeaCat ferry in June has helped boost the passenger figures.
Last week, the SuperSeaCat carried more than 30,000 passengers and more than 7,000 vehicles.
